_comment: The Grade 3 Science standalone lesson build, described for ../../mathematics/lesson-app-tools and built by ../lesson-kit. Order here IS the lesson number. Thirteen lessons organised by the sub-strands of Cambridge Primary Science 0097 Stage 3 (51 objectives), NOT by the units of the 0846-aligned course under science/grade-3/data, so progress is written under l01..l13 - see THE UNIT PROBLEM in wire-progress.py. objectiveFloors are recorded at the measured value after each build and may rise, not fall.
subject: science
_sittings: Two sittings per lesson (Grade 3 validation, area 17): each lesson is cut at the step nearest its halfway point, with a break card. Read by lesson-kit/_shell.py.
hubStrands: The five types of enquiry; asking questions that can be tested; predicting, staying safe, choosing equipment, measuring in standard units, looking things up, recording in tables and diagrams; patterns, conclusions and bar charts; diagrams and physical models.

What the parts of a flowering plant do and what a plant needs; the groups of animals and what marks each one out; the brain, heart, lungs, stomach and intestine; living, once alive and never alive; how young animals grow up; food chains.
Solids, liquids and gases and how they differ; mixtures, and separating them with a sieve, a magnet or a filter; dissolving.

Measuring forces with a forcemeter; gravity; friction on rough and smooth surfaces; light through transparent, translucent and opaque materials; shadows and their size; magnets, their poles, attracting and repelling.
Earth as the source of every material we use; fossils; the Moon's changing shape, and how the Earth and Moon move; Earth, Sun and Moon as spheres.
How thinking has changed, how the things we use work, who uses science at work, and how what we do affects the world.
